summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the ESC ]0;title BEL format entry and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True only when a terminal and writing the control; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: tests and Black were not executed per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
